# appwrite_topic (Resource)

Manages an Appwrite messaging topic.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appwrite_topic" "announcements" {
  id   = "announcements"
  name = "announcements"
}

resource "appwrite_topic" "alerts" {
  id        = "alerts"
  name      = "alerts"
  subscribe = ["users"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The topic ID.
- `name` (String) The topic name.

### Optional

- `subscribe` (List of String) Subscribe permissions.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The topic creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format.
- `updated_at` (String) The topic last update timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import appwrite_topic.announcements announcements
```
